title: WEG Announces US$250 Million Investment in Mexico and the Creation of 2,000 New Jobs
author: Sugeyry Romina Gándara
content:
_This article by[Sugeyry Romina
Gándara](https://www.sinembargo.mx/author/sugeyry_gandara/) originally
appeared in the [November 12, 2026 edition of
SinEmbargo](https://www.sinembargo.mx/4902665/weg-anuncia-una-inversion-
de-250-mdd-en-mexico-y-la-creacion-de-2-mil-nuevos-empleos/), a Mexican
digital news outlet._

_The investment planned for the next four years will allow the company to
expand its industrial capacity in Mexico._

_-Developing story_

**Mexico City, November 12 (SinEmbargo).–** WEG’s vice president of
Sustainability and Institutional Relations, **Daniel Marteleto Godinho** ,
announced this Thursday an investment of [**US$250 million in
Mexico**](https://www.sinembargo.mx/tag/economia/) between now and 2030 to
install a new plant in **Hidalgo** , a project through which the company
expects to generate **2,000 direct jobs** and **4,000 indirect jobs** , as
well as expand its industrial capacity in the country.

> “President, today we are announcing an investment of US$250 million in
> Mexico that will allow us to expand our industrial capabilities and generate
> another 2,000 direct jobs in the country, as well as an estimated 4,000
> indirect jobs,” Godinho said during President Claudia Sheinbaum Pardo’s
> morning press conference.

During his remarks, the executive explained that WEG has had a presence in
Mexico for more than 25 years, where it employs more than 6,000 people and
operates four industrial parks and 15 industrial buildings in Hidalgo, the
State of Mexico (Edomex) and Nuevo León. He also noted that the company has a
network of more than 500 distributors and serves more than 2,000 clients
nationwide.

> “The decision to make this new investment reflects our confidence in Mexico
> and our conviction that the country has a great opportunity to continue
> strengthening its role amid the technological revolution we are
> experiencing,” he added.
